Checklist Item: Requirement Review - Verify requirements are clear, complete, testable
Platform & Device Coverage - Decide supported OS versions and devices
Test Strategy Setup - Define scope, levels, manual vs automation
Test Environment Planning - Setup build sharing, backend availability, test data
UI/UX Review - Validate wireframes/mockups, usability, platform guidelines
Test Case Preparation - Draft high-level & edge case scenarios
Build Validation - Installation, launch, navigation smoke test
API/Integration Checks - Verify request/response, offline & failure cases
Basic Security & Permissions - Ensure least permissions, secure storage
Logging & Crash Handling - Validate error handling, crash reporting setup
Regression Coverage - Ensure stability across devices & OS versions
Store Readiness - Validate app icon, name, version, compliance
